description: This file defines the interface and data structures for UCI (Uplink Control Information) allocation in a 5G NR scheduler, including the uci_allocator class and uci_allocation struct.

classes.name: uci_allocator
classes.description: Interface for UCI allocation strategies, including methods for HARQ-ACK, SR, and CSI opportunities, multiplexing UCI on PUSCH, and status queries.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Resets internal counters for acknowledged PDSCHs per slot.

methods.name: alloc_harq_ack
methods.description: Allocates HARQ-ACK resource for a UE, returning UCI allocation details if successful.

methods.name: alloc_sr_opportunity
methods.description: Allocates SR opportunities for a UE.

methods.name: alloc_csi_opportunity
methods.description: Allocates CSI opportunities for a UE.

methods.name: multiplex_uci_on_pusch
methods.description: Transfers UCI from PUCCH to PUSCH, updating the respective grants.

methods.name: get_scheduled_pdsch_counter_in_ue_uci
methods.description: Returns the count of scheduled PDSCHs for a UE's UCI at a given slot.

methods.name: has_harq_ack_on_common_pucch_res
methods.description: Checks if a HARQ-ACK UCI exists on a common PUCCH resource for a UE.
